method: Fixed two-wall selection; 200 samples, first separately, 50 warmup then 150 measured. Six synthetic cases in fixed order. Preparations are session-cold, not process-cold. CPU service timings and planned upload bytes only; no React, snapping, GPU, native or frame claim. windowBaseMs plus windowCompositionMs measure the previous rebuild path; stableWindowCompositionMs measures the current composition with a reused basis, separately. Validation outside timing.
